strong_favourite_lost.note: Model gave >=65% to the predicted outcome, but was wrong.

draw_predicted_as_win.note: Match was actually a draw; model predicted a decisive winner.

win_predicted_as_draw.note: Model predicted a draw; match actually had a winner.

elo_favourite_upset.note: Elo gap >100 in one side's favour, but the underdog won outright — a genuine upset regardless of what the model predicted; flags whether the model still over-trusted Elo in these cases.

knockout_stage_errors.note: Errors specifically in knockout matches (higher stakes, single match, small sample per stage).

extra_time_or_penalties.note: Match went to extra time or penalties — score-based features see a level match at 90 minutes; result depends on factors outside the model's inputs.

verdicts.strong_favourite_lost: consistent with baseline — not distinguishable from random
verdicts.draw_predicted_as_win: systematic — error rate notably above baseline
verdicts.win_predicted_as_draw: systematic — error rate notably above baseline
verdicts.elo_favourite_upset: systematic — error rate notably above baseline
